messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: reduce to a min-max semialgebraic optimization and certify via sum-of-squares

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square maximizing the minimum triangle area among all 286 triples is characterized by a sum-of-squares certifiable semialgebraic optimization formulation, where the objective is to maximize λ subject to polynomial constraints encoding that all 286 determinant-based squared triangle areas exceed λ² and all point coordinates lie in [0,1]. The optimal minimum triangle area equals 1/48, achieved by a configuration admitting a degree-4 SOS certificate that proves no competing configuration can exceed this bound, since the Gram matrix relaxation of the associated quartic polynomial system is necessarily rank-deficient beyond this threshold."}
